paragraphs: The Context lanes are the big branches that grew out of the same roots but went somewhere else: mainstream Nashville, Red Dirt, stomp-clap Americana, bluegrass, chamber folk, emo, heartland rock, grunge, shoegaze, post-punk, modern Southern rock, pop's country turns, Laurel Canyon and punk. Each gets a short entry with a few landmark records and a note on where it split from the V. They are here so the map has edges, and because many Core artists borrow from them.
